truth: Goodness — agathosyne — active goodness that confronts evil. Where kindness brings a meal, goodness overturns the table of the money-changers. It does what is right even when it is not nice.
source: Galatians 5:22, Hebrew: tov (Genesis 1 — God saw that it was tov)

waterings.insight: Agathosyne in PoT: active goodness that confronts concentrated power, not just rewards good actors. The CalibrationRecord (types.go) boosts well-calibrated submitters — but no concentration ceiling exists. A dominant well-calibrated submitter accumulates calibration bonuses AND domain coverage, creating a knowledge monopoly. Agathosyne demands the protocol confront this: calibration adjustments must be paired with domain concentration limits. Goodness overturns the table even when the table-owner has excellent acceptance rates.

applications.context: PoT protocol design — submitter concentration limits
applications.note: PoT needs a max_domain_concentration param: if submitter > X% of facts in domain, further submissions earn no calibration bonus and face a stake premium. Prevents knowledge capture even by trusted actors.
